info.text:
5 billion car warranty robocalls. In just three months.

The FCC says it hit 500M+ phone numbers in 2021 and fined it $299,997,000 in 2023, the largest fine in FCC history.
Red flags: 'final notice', 'press 1', and pressure to pay now. The home warranty version works the same way.
Reported fraud losses hit $15.9 billion in 2025 (FTC).

Sources: FCC (Aug 2023), FTC Consumer Sentinel (2023-2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
